## Professional Summary
Lead / Staff Product Designer and Design Technologist with 10+ years of digital product experience (designing complex enterprise software since 2016). Specializes in the intersection of UX strategy, scalable design systems, and frontend engineering for mission-critical enterprise platforms and emerging AI ecosystems. Track record includes architecting an in-house enterprise platform at Sberbank HQ replacing standard SAP Fiori for 15K+ monthly active users, and directing end-to-end product design for AI evaluation systems at QuantPi. Bridges the gap between product vision, complex business logic, and code through AI-augmented workflows (Claude Code, Codex, Storybook, React).

## Core Competencies & Skills
- **Product & Design Leadership:** UX Strategy, Complex Enterprise & B2B SaaS, Design Systems, Information Architecture (IA), Wireframing, Rapid Prototyping, Customer Discovery & Generative Research, Usability Testing, Cross-Functional Team Leadership.
- **Design Engineering & Technology:** Figma, Storybook, Design Tokens, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Webflow, Git, Terminal & AI CLI toolchains (Claude Code, Codex, Grok).
- **Domain Fluency:** Enterprise ERP / SAP Modernization, Financial Workflows & Analytics, AI Validation & LLM Model Governance, Risk Profiling.

## Work Experience

### Lead Product Designer / Design Strategist — QuantPi
*Location: Saarbrücken, Germany | Period: September 2022 – Present*
- Lead end-to-end product design, information architecture, and UX strategy for an enterprise AI testing and governance platform.
- Architect and govern two scalable design systems in Storybook, ensuring design-token synchronization across Figma and React frontend repositories.

### Lead Product & UX Designer (Enterprise Platforms) — Sberbank (Central Finance Dept, HQ)
*Location: Moscow | Period: June 2018 – August 2022*
- Directed the ground-up product design and architecture of an in-house enterprise platform created to replace standard SAP Fiori for the bank's Headquarters.
- Engineered complex transactional workflows, data grids, and approval systems scaling to 15K+ monthly active users across 10+ multidisciplinary squads.
- Established internal design standards and usability metrics, transforming fragmented legacy tools into modern, consumer-grade enterprise software.
- Successfully consolidated 100+ fragmented financial services into a unified product within 6 months from discovery to release.

### UI/UX Designer (ERP Competence Center) — Sberbank
*Location: Yekaterinburg | Period: June 2016 – June 2018*

### Economist & Financial Systems Analyst — Sberbank
*Location: Yekaterinburg | Period: January 2011 – June 2016*

## Key Projects & Impact
1. **QuantPi Platform (Enterprise AI Testing & Governance):** Full-cycle UX/UI for an AI testing system used by 5+ Enterprise clients. Built 10+ AI evaluation modules and model pipelines across 3 core services.
2. **CostPlatform (SAP Replacement):** Replaced SAP Fiori for 20K+ internal bank users by merging 100+ fragmented services into a single scalable product. Sole designer from discovery to release in 6 months. NPS increased significantly toward 80% target.
3. **AI Hub:** Enterprise AI governance platform for evaluating LLM systems against regulatory and trust frameworks (Trust Profiles, risk matrices, automated assessment pipelines).
